title: Keyword Frames Are Cluster Samples: How a Third of an npm Ecosystem Stayed Invisible
description: Measurement study of Model Context Protocol servers on npm. A keyword-built frame samples publishers rather than packages; the population size moves by a factor of 8.6 with the keyword chosen; a third of the enumerated population is machine-generated. The dependency resolver had four silent defects found only against a real npm install. No dimension shows elevated supply-chain risk. Includes all raw measurements, every invalidated run, and a record of each withdrawn figure.
